summary: Failed runs across all agents grouped by likely cause, so ops fixes causes, not single runs.
intent: Block: failed agent runs grouped by likely cause. A FilterBar (time, agent, status) over a listbox of clusters, largest first, each with its cause, count, status Badge (New / Known / Fixed / Regressed), affected agents and the trend in words; beside it the selected cluster's first and last seen, a LineChart over time, a sample failing call in a ToolCallCard opened to its error and a Table of recent runs. Open issue is the one solid primary.
useWhen: ops needs to see which causes break agent runs across many agents
a person decides whether a failure is known, should be muted or needs an issue
a fixed failure must show when it comes back (Regressed)
doNotUseWhen: a list of single failed runs to act on — AgentInbox
one run explained step by step — RunDetail
events and changes in general — ActivityFeed

clusters.note: { id, title, status: "new" | "known" | "fixed" | "regressed", count, agents: { name, src? }[], trend: number[] (oldest first), trendLabels?, firstSeen, lastSeen, sample: { name, summary?, args?, error, duration? }, runs: { id, label, href?, agent, when, step }[], mutedUntil? }[]. Sorted largest first. A fixed cluster that comes back should be passed as regressed.

onSelect.note: (id) => void. Click, or Up / Down / Home / End in the list.

filters.note: { time?, agent?, status? }. Uncontrolled when omitted. Agent and status filter the list; time is a label, so pass the clusters for that window.

onMarkKnown.note: (id) => void. Mark known, outline; hidden when already known.

onMute.note: (id) => void. Mute 24h, ghost; shows mutedUntil while muted.

onOpenIssue.note: (id) => void. Open issue, the one solid primary.

layout: header, then the filtered cluster list beside the selected cluster in layout-split--secondary
the block is its own inline-size container and takes the full width; below --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem) of block width the list sits over the cluster

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
the clusters are a listbox; each option has aria-selected, Up / Down / Home / End move the selection and focus with it
status is a word in a Badge and the trend is words with an icon, never colour alone
counts use NumberTransition with a spoken label ("12 failed runs")
the selected cluster is a section labelled by its h3 cause
the sample call is a ToolCallCard opened to its error; recent runs are a captioned kit Table

doNot: Do not invent a local ErrorGroups, IncidentList or FailureTable
Do not list single runs as clusters (AgentInbox)
Open issue is the one solid primary; Mark known is outline and Mute ghost
snippet: <FailureClusters clusters={clusters} filters={{ time: "Last 24 hours" }} onMarkKnown={markKnown} onMute={mute} onOpenIssue={openIssue} />
